# Where to Watch Dakota


by Angel | September 17, 2026


When a fallen Marine’s combat dog arrives at a struggling Georgia farm, Dakota becomes much more than a new pet. She finds herself at the center of a grieving family’s life, helping a widow and her young daughter find comfort and courage as they work to keep their farm afloat.


But the family’s troubles go beyond grief. When a corrupt local sheriff threatens their future, Dakota becomes an unlikely protector as they fight to hold on to their home and find the strength to move forward together.


[Stream Dakota now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/dakota)


### **A Combat Dog Comes Home**


Dakota has already lived a life of service before she arrives in Georgia.


After losing her Marine handler, she is delivered to his widow and daughter. For a family already struggling with loss, welcoming a military working dog into their home brings a complicated mix of memories, responsibility, and hope.


As Dakota settles into her new surroundings, she forms a bond with the family that changes all of their lives.


### **A Family Fighting for Their Farm**


The family’s grief isn’t their only challenge.


Their Georgia farm is struggling, and keeping it afloat becomes increasingly difficult. When a corrupt local sheriff threatens their future, the family finds itself facing a fight they can’t afford to lose.


Dakota may be a dog, but she plays an important role in the family’s determination to protect their home. Her loyalty and courage become a source of strength as they confront the people standing in their way.


### **Standing Up for What’s Right**


As the family faces pressure from the local sheriff, *Dakota* becomes more than a story about a grieving family and their dog.


The conflict forces them to decide how far they’re willing to go to protect their home and what they believe is right. It also highlights the importance of standing together when doing the right thing comes at a cost.


Fans appreciated that aspect of the story, describing it as a family-friendly movie that shows how honest people sometimes have to choose between right and wrong while considering their family.


### **A Movie the Whole Family Can Watch**


*Dakota* has something for different generations of viewers.


Kids get a loyal, heroic dog to cheer for. Parents get a story about family, grief, military sacrifice, and perseverance. And everyone gets the opportunity to see a remarkable bond between a family and the animal that unexpectedly becomes part of their lives.


One Rotten Tomatoes reviewer called Dakota’s charm “irresistible” and described the film as a wholesome experience. Another praised its rural Georgia setting, strong performances, and appeal to both kids and adults.


That combination makes *Dakota* a natural choice for a family movie night.


### **Watch** ***Dakota*** **on Angel**


From a fallen Marine’s combat dog to a family fighting to save their Georgia farm, *Dakota* is a story about loyalty, courage, and finding strength in unexpected places. With a memorable canine hero at its center and a story the whole family can experience together, *Dakota* offers an adventure with plenty of heart.
